text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
So, Yukino, was that you the other day
having
trouble snagging a spot at the
sink?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
There's jus' so many beautiful girls here
at Tracen,
I wasn't sure if it'd be okay for
me to hog the
mirror... You know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What're you sayin'? You're as cute as
they come!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
The dorm's available to all its members.
Use the
washroom mirror whenever ya
want!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but you let me know if someone
won't make
room. I'll give 'em a piece of
my mind!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you're just so kind—like a
mother! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah well. I'd be honored to be a mama to
a cute
little student like you.
